fact: 1941年3月11日，罗斯福签署《租借法案》（An Act to Promote the Defense of the United States, H.R. 1776），授权总统向「其防御被视为对美国国防至关重要」的国家出售、转让、出租或出借任何防御物资；参议院以60:31、众议院以317:71通过。

sources.title: Report to Congress on Lend-Lease Operations for Year Ended March 11, 1942 – GovInfo
sources.quote: The Lend-Lease Act-"An Act to Promote the Defense of the United States"-became law on March 11, 1941.

sources.title: Deschler's Precedents Vol.3 – GovInfo
sources.quote: On Mar. 8, 1941, the Senate by a vote of yeas 60, nays 31, not voting 4, amended and agreed to, and the House by a vote of yeas 317, nays 71 ... agreed to Senate amendments and passed, H.R. 1776

fact: 1941年12月7日（星期日）日本海军偷袭珍珠港，击沉击伤美军战列舰8艘；次日罗斯福在国会发表「国耻演说」，国会仅以众议员珍妮特·兰金一票反对通过对日宣战，罗斯福当日下午签署宣战令；12月11日德意对美宣战。

sources.title: The Day of Infamy Speech – U.S. National Archives
sources.quote: At 12:30 p.m. on December 8, 1941, President Franklin D. Roosevelt appeared before a Joint Session of Congress to deliver his War Message ... and asked Congress to declare the existence of a state of war between Japan and the United States.

sources.title: Joint Address to Congress Leading to a Declaration of War Against Japan – FDR Presidential Library (Marist)
sources.quote: The Senate and House of Representatives approved the war declaration unanimously with the exception of one vote - Congresswoman Jeannette Rankin became the first member of Congress to vote "no" on both the declaration

fact: 1941年1月，克莱斯勒公司在底特律动工兴建「坦克兵工厂」（Detroit Arsenal Tank Plant），造价2000万美元，是当时世界上最大的同类工厂；1941年初美国汽车工业开始向坦克、军用卡车与飞机发动机转产。

sources.title: Defense Official Bulletin, Jan. 14, 1941 – GovInfo
sources.quote: Construction of tank arsenal is proceeding on schedule ... the tank arsenal being built by the Chrysler Corporation at Detroit, Mich. ... The arsenal, the largest of its type in the world, is expected to cost $20,000,000.

fact: 1942年1月16日罗斯福签署行政令成立战时生产委员会（War Production Board, WPB），主席唐纳德·纳尔逊对全国战争采购与生产计划拥有「最终决定权」，取代此前的供应优先与分配局（SPAB），并吸收生产管理局（OPM）职能。

sources.title: Victory: Official Weekly Bulletin, Vol.3 No.3 – GovInfo
sources.quote: President Roosevelt on January 16 signed the Executive order creating the War Production Board, with a chairman to exercise powers of "final" decision in general direction over the war procurement and production program.

fact: 1941年2月起物价管理办公室（OPA前身）依据旧《战争权力法》对选定商品设定最高限价；1941年4月罗斯福发布行政令8734号成立「物价管理与民用供应办公室」（OPACS），授权其采取一切合法步骤防止价格螺旋、生活成本上升、暴利与通胀。

sources.title: Economics of the Home Front – GovInfo
sources.quote: Henderson began to set price maximums on selected items in February 1941, using the authority of the old War Powers Act.

sources.title: Full Employment without Inflation: Lessons from the Emergency Price Control Act of 1942 – LPE Project
sources.quote: In April, witnessing rising prices, the President issued Executive Order 8734 to strengthen Henderson's program, establishing the Office of Price Administration and Civilian Supply (OPACS)

fact: 1942年1月30日罗斯福签署《紧急物价管制法》（Emergency Price Control Act），授予OPA法定权力稳定物价与租金并处罚违规者；价格管理官被授权在调查后设定「公平合理」的最高价，并须参照1941年10月1日—1942年的价格水平。

sources.title: The General Maximum Price Regulation, Bulletin No.879 – BLS/FRASER
sources.quote: The Emergency Price Control Act of 1942, signed by the President January 30, 1942, gave to the Office of Price Administration statutory power to stabilize prices and rents and authority to punish violators.

sources.title: Economics of the Home Front – GovInfo
sources.quote: Congress passed the Emergency Price Control Act which the President signed on January 30, 1942.

fact: 租借法案1941年3月11日生效后，美国首先向英国提供物资；1941年6月22日德苏战争爆发后，罗斯福于11月7日宣布苏联符合租借资格，至1942年3月11日首份年度租借报告时，已向英国及反轴心国国家提供了「每一种对总体战争有用的物资、服务与信息」。

sources.title: Report to Congress on Lend-Lease Operations for Year Ended March 11, 1942 – GovInfo
sources.quote: It defines "defense article" and "defense information" as broadly as modern warfare requires, to include every type of material, services and information useful in total war.

sources.title: First Report Under the Act of March 11, 1941 – GovInfo
sources.quote: The main object of this Act is to promote the defense of the United States by supplying material aid to those nations whose defense is vital to our defense.

fact: 1941年美国汽车工业转产：通用汽车总裁威廉·克努森离开GM出任生产管理局（OPM，后为WPB前身）主席；克莱斯勒底特律坦克兵工厂1941年1月动工，1942年起生产M3格兰特/李式坦克；汽车分支主管欧内斯特·坎兹勒被WPB主席纳尔逊授予「我拥有的全部权力」以推动汽车业转产。

sources.title: Victory: Official Weekly Bulletin, Vol.3 No.4 – GovInfo
sources.quote: appointment of Ernest Kanzler as chief of the automotive branch, with, as Mr. Nelson said, "all the authority that I've got" to convert the industry to war

sources.title: Winning the war with the 1941 Jimmy Deuce-and-a-Half – General Motors
sources.quote: President Franklin D. Roosevelt reached out to General Motors President William Knudsen to take on the enormous task of directing production for the war effort. Knudsen agreed to leave GM to work for Roosevelt as Chairman of the Office of Production Management, an agency that later became the War Production Board.

fact: 1941年底特律与西海岸军工工厂因男性被征兵与扩产同时出现劳动力短缺， openings 向已婚女性开放；WPB在1942年1月成立后推动「临时女职工」招募，底特律汽车厂女工1941—1943年人数成倍增长，周工资按工会集体谈判协议执行。

sources.title: The American Home Front During World War II – U.S. National Park Service
sources.quote: Allied with Japan, Germany and Italy declared war on the United States. ... With only one vote against, Congress complied.
